title: feat: add FirewallBackend field to compat GET /info
body:
## Summary
- Populate the Docker Engine API v1.49 `FirewallBackend` field in the
  compat `GET /info` response from `network.firewall_driver` in
  containers.conf.
- Returns nil (field omitted) when no driver is explicitly configured,
  since an empty value means netavark auto-selects and reporting a
  specific driver would invent backend information.

Fixes #30162
Refs #30159
